provenance.extraction: pdftotext -bbox-layout; printed cells verbatim, whitespace normalized
provenance.eventTurns: All 75 supplied Mazzo_Eventi/fronti original images, order icons AND printed Avanzano names visually verified; explicit source table VERIFIED_EVENT_TURNS in importer, independent of legacy eventi.ts.
provenance.eventTurnVerification: 375 order positions and all 75 Avanzano fields checked on diagnostic contact sheets; no discrepancies with legacy values.
provenance.unlockFlags: src/data/mazzi.ts unlocks_special matched by exact ID; appendix A omits these flags
provenance.unlockRule: Rulebook p13: draw one special only if the printed card has Sblocca carta speciale.
provenance.unlockGraphicAudit: All 78 supplied ZIP faction fronts checked by OCR AND visually at the fixed unlock-banner region; only C004/C006/C015 have a banner. These three complete fronts also visually verified.
rulings: Corrected rulebook p17/p19: one defending Scudo Missilistico cancels all attacking Missili balistici bonuses. No override of the latest PDF is required.
gaps: Unlock flags C032/C045/NI34 are inherited by exact ID, not independently graphic-verified: corresponding original fronts are absent from the supplied faction ZIPs. Appendix A does not list unlock flags. No additional flags are invented.
